motions.name: broken_1
motions.line: Blood and tears......It's all the same to me.

motions.name: broken_2
motions.line: We are tools used to replace humans on the battlefield. Therefore, a human life is saved every time we die in their place.

motions.name: broken_3
motions.line: I will not forget this pain......

motions.name: broken_4
motions.line: Commander, you will not have the chance for remorse for many situations out there if you act too rashly.

motions.name: broken_5
motions.line: Being together with everyone is my honour.

motions.name: touch_1
motions.line: I like rainy days. The rain lets my expression look...more natural.

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: Commander, I've brought the goods you desired.

motions.name: touch_3
motions.line: I wonder what sort of flowers will bloom this time?

motions.name: touch_5

motions.name: wedding
motions.line: Haha... The floral fragrance here exudes an aura completely opposite of mine.<>I've always thought that only sorrow can make a person cry...<>If what I am feeling now can be expressed by tears...then I might not be able to stop myself.

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: Commander, it seems like it will rain soon. Would you like to go for a walk? ...Bring a smaller umbrella so we can be closer together...
